subject: prd/abandoned-feature-retirement
statement: Verify retirement authority and cleanup from a fresh mainline-only transport clone after squash merge and branch deletion.
intent: Record the approved mitigation for this exact requirement-ledger risk.
rationale: Authority that depends on a proposal head or unavailable object cannot govern later deletion. FR-11 and the rollout require retained mainline evidence at both proposal boundaries.
fit_criterion: Fresh-clone verification reproduces the exact authority and cleanup verdict after each head branch is deleted; missing-history controls refuse.
